suggestion.topic: Python AsyncIO vs Threading: When to Stop Blocking Your Loop
suggestion.rationale: Developers continually confuse I/O-bound concurrency with CPU parallelism, resulting in sluggish FastAPI or Tornado servers. Addressing the event loop bottleneck against traditional OS threads captures massive search traffic from developers optimizing real-time web services.
suggestion.hook_angle: Stop using threads for I/O-bound tasks in Python—you're literally destroying your app's event loop performance.
